problem.original_text:
Simplify and plot on x in [-2,4]:
f(x) = (x^2 - 4)/(x - 2)
Show domain restriction and hole.
problem.normalized_text:
Simplify and plot on x in [-2,4]:
f(x) = (x^2 - 4)/(x - 2)
Show domain restriction and hole.

steps.title: Cancel
steps.explanation: Cancel common factor (x-2), valid except where x=2 (removable).

steps.title: Result
steps.explanation: Simplified function is the line y=x+2; the hole occurs at x=2 with y=4.

steps.title: Plotting
steps.explanation: Plot on [-2,4]: draw y=x+2 over interval but omit point (2,4).

steps.title: Domain
steps.explanation: Domain: all real numbers except x=2; note the function is not defined at the hole.

steps.title: Points
steps.explanation: Key numeric values: f(-2)=0, f(0)=2, f(4)=6 helpful for graphing.

plots.title: f(x) = (x^2-4)/(x-2) on [-2,4] with hole at x=2
